articles.title: Shapoor Mistry backs Tata Sons listing, calls it opportunity for greater accountability
articles.summary: Mistry, whose family’s Shapoorji Pallonji Group owns about 18.4% of Tata Sons, said the RBI’s decision had provided “full clarity” and that he looked forward to working constructively with Tata Sons and the Tata Trusts

articles.title: India’s EV push faces subsidy test as Centre asks industry to make economics work
articles.summary: After years of incentives helping put electric vehicles on Indian roads, the industry faces a harder test: whether localisation, scale, and falling costs can make EVs affordable enough to reduce their dependence on government support. The first challenge was adoption; the next is building a market that can increasingly stand on its own.
